# Provider Inventory

Answer these before filling in `gaiax.config.yaml`'s `participant:` section.
Changing the answer later means re-notarizing your Legal Registration
Number credential — get it right the first time.

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| Which legal entity is the Gaia-X Participant? | |
| Registration number type (vatID / leiCode / EUID / EORI) | |
| Registration number | |
| Country of registration | |
| Headquarters address (country subdivision, ISO 3166-2) | |
| Does this entity operate on behalf of a consortium/parent org? If so, name it. | |
| Who is the human contact responsible for keeping this identity/credentials current? | |

If more than one organization is involved in the project (a university lab,
a spin-off, a consortium), name all of them here and mark which ONE holds
the Gaia-X identity. The others can be referenced in the Service Offering's
description, but only one entity can be the signing Participant.
